sources.note: Main website. Identifies StreamlineMD as a revenue cycle solutions company serving radiology and interventional specialists. Subsidiary of PRC Medical. Offers coding/billing services and certified EHR/PM software.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists StreamlineMD EHR v15.0, certification details, pricing structure (cloud subscription and license purchase options), and links to EHI export, FHIR API docs, and real-world testing.

About page. Confirms wholly owned subsidiary of PRC Medical with 48+ years history. Cloud-based revenue cycle software and services for radiology/interventional specialists. Serves clients in 42 states.

FAQ page with detailed feature descriptions. Lists 500+ procedure templates, AI scribe, procedure drawing tool, prior auth tracking, inventory management, PACS integration, vitals interface, nurse notes, charge capture automation.

2022 press release about Strategic Radiology selecting StreamlineMD as preferred vendor. Describes product features including scheduling, clinical documentation, charge capture, PACS/DICOM integration, prior auth tracking, inventory management, mobile app, and marketing management.

Third-party review site. Lists features: medical billing, patient portal, medical reporting, appointment management, lab integration, e-prescribing, compliance tracking, document management, telemedicine, customizable forms, claims management, referral management.

Third-party review site. 3.8/5 from 23 reviews. Notes specialty-specific customization as strength, being overwhelming for smaller practices as weakness. Lists integrations with AppwoRx and Hitachi VidiStar.
Original press wire for the Strategic Radiology partnership announcement. Confirms national reach and specialty focus.
